title: Closed immersion pullback unit is epi
statement: Let i:Z -> Y be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion] and F an O_Y-module. The unit at F of the chosen tensor-pullback/pushforward adjunction [def-pc-module-pullback] is an epimorphism.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 08KS (lemma-i-star-equivalence), stalkwise argument; Sheaves, Lemmas 0098 and 00AE. Read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08KS because the literature checkout is not present on this machine.

proof.text: Choose the canonical adjunction. At x=i(z), compose the closed-pushforward stalk map with the tensor-pullback stalk isomorphism. Their germ formulas send the unit applied to a germ m to 1 tensor m. The ring map on stalks is surjective for a closed immersion. Mathlib TensorProduct.mk_surjective then gives surjectivity of this composite; both comparison maps are injective, so the unit stalk map is surjective.
Outside the closed image the target stalk is a subsingleton, hence the stalk map is surjective.

For two maps a,b out of the pushforward pullback with equal composites with the unit, surjectivity of each unit stalk makes the stalk maps of a,b equal. Mathlib TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext makes a,b equal on sections, so the unit is epi. Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app expresses the chosen unit as the canonical unit followed by the pushforward of an isomorphism; epi_comp finishes.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 08KS, with the explicit local tensor quotient calculation and adjunction transport written out.

lean.statement:
theorem closedImmersion_unit_epi {Y Z : Scheme.{w}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (F : Y.Modules) :
    Epi ((Classical.choice (nonempty_tensorPullbackAdjunction i)).unit.app F)
